on the road.speaker: Harald
text: I see you are on the road again. I hope you are well prepared for the journey ahead.
The road can be dangerous, so make sure you have enough supplies and stay alert.
Take this map with you. It will help you navigate through the terrain and find your way to your destination.

options.text: Thank you, Harald. I will be careful.
I appreciate your advice, but I think I can handle it on my own.

on the road.speaker: Harald
text: Remember, the journey is not just about reaching your destination, but also about the experiences you have along the way.
